summary.text: Karen Ebel is a Democratic state representative from Merrimack 7 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, she has served in the House since 2012.

paragraphs.text: Karen Ebel earned a degree from Trinity College and a J.D. from Georgetown University Law Center, and her career experience includes working as an attorney.
Ebel's tenure in the New Hampshire House began in 2012, according to Ballotpedia.

She served on the Public Works and Highways Committee in several sessions between 2013 and 2020, and in 2023-2024 she served on the House Finance Committee and its Division I and on the Rules Committee.
